scheme_name: Banglashree for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: Subsidy for Patent Registration (PRS)
other_conditions: Must belong to the manufacturing sector.
Production should have started on or after 1st April 2019.
Date of Commencement of Commercial Production should be between 1st April 2020 and 31st March 2025.
Business/organization should be in the private sector, cooperative sector, joint sector undertaking, owned and managed by the State Government, or an Industrial SHG.
benefits_summary: Reimbursement of 50% of patent registration expenses up to ₹5,00,000 per enterprise.
